messages:
Maria: Quick ask — post-launch retargeting push needs a small benchmark visual package and a leadflow diagram. Goal: social + landing hero + one explainer diagram that maps how leads get routed. Can design team take this? Need first pass by tomorrow EOD. Figma file: https://www.figma.com/file/xxxxxx/post-launch-retargeting-assets

Leo: Yep, we can. Can you drop the metrics+copy we want highlighted? Also confirm export sizes and whether we need animated GIFs or static assets only.

Maria: KPIs to call out: p95 latency target 150ms, avg token cost reduction ~2.5x vs baseline, reliability SLA 99.9%. Copy drafts (short):
- Tile A: "Lower latency, lower cost — same quality"
- Tile B: "Run inference smarter: 2.5x cost savings"
- CTA for hero: "See the benchmark"
Use updated brand color tokens (token names in figma). No motion needed for hero, micro GIF ok for social teasers.

Aj: Suggest we A/B test two headlines: latency-first vs cost-first. If design can hand two variants, growth will run quick test.

Leo: Got it. Export specs I need:
```
hero: 1200x628 px (jpg + 2x @2x png)
social microtile: 1080x1080 px (png)
banner/diagram: 1600x900 px (svg + png fallback)
animated teaser (optional): 800x800 gif, 3s loop, 24fps
```
Also need raw numbers for the callouts (exact percentages).

Maria: Raw numbers: latency p50 45ms, p95 150ms, cost/token baseline $0.006 -> optimized $0.0024 (approx 60% cost reduction). Use rounded phrasing: "~2.5x lower cost" or "60% lower cost".

Sam: Please include a leadflow diagram that shows: landing form -> enrichment (Clearbit) -> Redwood scoring webhook -> SFDC lead queue -> AE triage -> demo booking (Cal). Also show fallback to CS for high-priority customers. Sales needs that to train SDRs.

Leo: Copy length for diagram labels should be short. I'll place longer descriptions in hover notes in figma. Any legal/brand constraints?

Ana: Quick legal check: for EU/UK-facing creatives include small privacy blurb on landing and do not imply guaranteed SLAs for self-serve. For claims, use qualifiers: "based on internal benchmark" or "typical results". Also send localization notes if we need non-English variants.

Maria: Good point — add footer line: "Results from internal benchmark; actual results may vary." Keep it 10-12 px. Localization for DE/FR/JP might be needed after launch; plan for copy file.

Leo: Timeline: I'll do a grayscale wireframe tonight, colors + assets tomorrow morning, drop Figma link to first pass by 6pm PT. Can we get a design review at 7pm PT?

Aj: 7pm works for growth team. We'll pick variant and set up 24h test.

Sam: When you share final source, include exported SVGs + a flattened PNG for SFDC and the literal copy text in a single `copy.txt`. Also include a simple JSON mapping for leadflow endpoints we can hand to eng:
```
{
  "form_endpoint": "https://hooks.redwood.ai/retarget",
  "scoring_webhook": "https://hooks.redwood.ai/score",
  "sf_queue": "SFDC: Retargeting_Leads"
}
```
(we'll update actual URLs later)

Leo: Will include `copy.txt` and `assets.zip` in the figma handoff.

benchbot: Deployment reminder: marketing landing route needs the tracking params utm_campaign=retarget-2026 and the backend needs a new webhook consumer.

Maria: Perfect. Thanks everyone — leaning on Leo for first pass. Ping me in thread when the figma link is up. :rocket:

Leo: Will do. :thumbsup:

Ana: Noted on legal copy, will sign off on final assets before publish. :white_check_mark:
